name: specbinder
description: Review, automate and split SpecBinder Gherkin spec files, with review findings shown in the spec editor of IntelliJ IDEA.

interface.shortDescription: Review, automate and split SpecBinder Gherkin specs.
interface.longDescription: Skills for SpecBinder Gherkin spec files (.specb / .feature): review them against your project's spec-writing guidelines with the findings shown in IntelliJ IDEA's spec editor, turn them into JUnit 5 tests, restructure the spec folders, and split spec files that cover too much.
defaultPrompt: Review the spec file open in the IDE
Automate this spec as a JUnit test
Split this spec file into one file per Ability
